title: spin-aware-amk v1.0.0: spin-resolved automated reaction networks with automatic MECP localisation — code and supporting data
description: Spin-resolved extension of the AutoMeKin chemical-reaction-network engine: a spin-capable GFN2-xTB exploration engine, automatic enumeration of close-lying spin states (M1), automatic minimum-energy-crossing-point localisation at flagged crossings (M2), MECP nodes with non-adiabatic edges in the reaction graph (M3), nonadiabatic transition-state-theory rates and microkinetic post-analysis (M4), and a multireference diagnostic gate (M0) that decides from the expectation value of the total spin operator whether a node is single-reference-clean before single-determinant methods are applied to it. Supporting code for the accompanying methods paper. This record archives the released code together with the supporting data of the accompanying methods paper: the worked validation and blind-exploration runs, the gate evidence logs for all three reported verdicts, the MECP localisations, the single-point energetics, the CASSCF/NEVPT2 and spin-orbit outputs, the nonadiabatic rate inputs, and the source data behind every figure. See README.md for the file-by-file mapping onto the sections of the paper.
notes: Supported by Internal Funds KU Leuven, grant iBOF/25/022. Calculations used the KU Leuven 'dirac' cluster and the Flemish Supercomputer Centre (VSC), funded by the Research Foundation - Flanders (FWO) and the Flemish Government.
